dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent closed 'O' structures along the dorsal ridge exhibit thin, irregular dark perimeters (approx. 2-5 pixels wide) with a distinct gradient transition to lighter grey interiors. Multiple interlocking 'C' and 'U' shaped arcs are concentrated on the mid-lateral flank, characterized by jagged, high-contrast dark boundaries and speckled internal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters (2-8 pixel diameter) concentrated on the cervical/neck region and around the eye. Low density of isolated, solid low-intensity dark spots is observed across the lower posterior flank, showing no discernible internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper dorsal arch form an elongated scalene triangle. Four high-intensity blobs on the lateral neck region form a near-linear, downward-curving trajectory relative to the eye's position.
